data.narrative:
Until is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis that has raised $106M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-sector peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses Until's $106M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $212M. Peer-Median anchoring was not executable due to an insufficient narrow peer set—while 8 same-sector comps exist, filtering for same-stage or adjacent-stage raised fewer than the 3-datapoint minimum needed for reliability. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Until's revenue is not on file; the public sector P/S median of 5.6x cannot be applied without this input.

The triangulated range is $180M (low) to $244M (high), with a median of $212M. This range reflects the limited methodological scope: reliance on a single applicable method introduces material uncertainty. Key unknowns include Until's clinical progress, capital efficiency relative to peers, and the intended use of this funding tranche—all of which would typically inform stage-based step-ups but are not quantified here.
